mercy_translation.text:
Every true prophet who wishes to settle among you is worthy of his food. Likewise, a true teacher is also worthy, like a worker, of his food.

Therefore take every firstfruit from the produce of the winepress and threshing floor, and from cattle and sheep, and give it to the prophets; for they are your high priests.

If you have no prophet, give it to the poor.

If you make bread, take the first portion and give it according to the commandment. Likewise, when you open a jar of wine or oil, take the first portion and give it to the prophets.

From money, clothing, and every possession, take the first portion, as seems right to you, and give according to the commandment.

translator_notes: Direct Mercy translation from the Greek public-domain source.
The text adapts firstfruits language to support prophets, teachers, and the poor.
